# sonarqube_group_members (Data Source)

Lists the active members of a group, sorted by login.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every member of a group.
data "sonarqube_group_members" "developers" {
  group = "developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Exact group name.

### Optional

- `ignore_missing` (Boolean) Return no members, rather than fail, when the group does not exist.
- `login_name` (String) Only return this user (exact login), e.g. to test membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `members` (Attributes List) Group members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `login_name` (String) User login.
- `name` (String) User display name.
